analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: S&P 500: while 7460 holds as resistance, the desk targets the 200-day moving average at 7320, then the 38.2% retracement at 7260. A break above 7460 would trigger a rebound toward 7505 and 7575.
DAX failed to take out the previous high at 26,620 yesterday. While 26,415 holds as resistance, the desk targets 26,165, then 26,105. A break above 26,415 targets 26,575 and 26,620.
EuroStoxx50: while 6250 holds as resistance, the desk targets 6200, then 6175. A break above 6250 targets 6305 and 6335.
SMI: while 15,005 holds as resistance, the desk targets 14,910, then 14,860. A break above 15,005 targets 15,080 and 15,145.
Intraday trend is down for all four indices. The 2-5 day trend is down for the S&P 500 (below 7620) and up for the DAX, EuroStoxx50 and SMI (above 26,105, 6,200 and 14,860 respectively).
risk_factors: A break above 7460 in the S&P 500 would invalidate the near-term down-move view.
A break above 26,415 in the DAX would invalidate the near-term down-move view.
A break above 6250 in the EuroStoxx50 would invalidate the near-term down-move view.
A break above 15,005 in the SMI would invalidate the near-term down-move view.
